nodes.label: browser-environment-hygiene.md
nodes.rationale: Rule prohibiting autonomous browser launches, focus-stealing, or game tab clicks; zero-focus background hygiene.

nodes.label: modern-web-conventions.md
nodes.rationale: Rule for web conventions: Unix timestamps in seconds, a11y, and forms.

nodes.label: Agent Harness
nodes.rationale: Shared repository sources including specialist definitions, rules, skills, scripts, and tests in .agents/. Supplement AGENTS.md; root and its owning documents take precedence.

nodes.label: BigNumber Precision
nodes.rationale: Core principle: Forge Points, Great Building locks, Arc bonuses, and military boosts use BigNumber precision arithmetic to prevent floating-point drift.

nodes.label: Dual Intake Paths
nodes.rationale: Two read-only observation channels for game traffic: DevTools network listener and MAIN-world content-script bridge. Both feed the same dispatcher.

nodes.label: Dynamic Metadata Streaming
nodes.rationale: Core principle: game metadata streams dynamically from InnoGames CDNs and RPC responses; no hardcoded entity statistics or static game dumps in src/.

nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Tool for semantic extraction and knowledge graph generation. Used for AST refresh and querying structural questions. Local graph is the only graph produced by this repository.

nodes.label: Passive Observation
nodes.rationale: Core principle: extension reads game traffic through two read-only intake paths (DevTools listener and MAIN-world observer) without writing back, botting, or automating gameplay.

nodes.label: Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: npm run verify command that runs version, reference audit, formatting, linting, type checking, RPC/i18n contracts, tests, focused coverage, dev build, and production bundle budgets. Must pass before commit.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.rationale: Canonical agent entrypoint. Defines hard boundaries, commands, shared agent harness, and Graphify usage.

nodes.label: bignumber-precision.md
nodes.rationale: Rule for BigNumber arithmetic precision invariants for Great Buildings and lock calculations.

nodes.label: dynamic-runtime-metadata.md
nodes.rationale: Rule for strict prohibition against static metadata or JSON dumps in src/.

nodes.label: release-policy.md
nodes.rationale: Rule forbidding auto version bumps or git tags during routine verification.

nodes.label: workspace-structure.md
nodes.rationale: Rule for directory organization, workspace scoping, worktrees, and artifact boundaries.

nodes.label: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.rationale: Owns contribution policy, validation, external tool prerequisites, agent harness, Git workflow, and MCP configuration.

nodes.label: validation-harness.md
nodes.rationale: Design of validation harness, change-type matrix, command surface, report outputs, and CI gates.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.rationale: Canonical shared entrypoint for a fresh clone. Describes core principles, requirements, building, and commands.

nodes.label: SECURITY.md
nodes.rationale: Owns security policy, data intake paths, page-spoofable messages, external publication, and product boundary.

nodes.label: Full Internationalization (i18n)
nodes.rationale: Core principle: all UI strings, tooltips, and labels support 7 locales with 100% key parity.

nodes.label: i18n-compliance.md
nodes.rationale: Rule for using i18n bindings for all user-visible text, tooltips, and labels.

nodes.label: options.html
nodes.rationale: HTML entry point for options page with form for user settings.

nodes.label: popup.html
nodes.rationale: HTML entry point for browser action popup.

nodes.label: Debug Mode
nodes.rationale: Runtime mode toggled via header icon, enabling verbose diagnostic logging across all extension layers with module-scoped tags.

nodes.label: debuggability-by-design.md
nodes.rationale: Rule for debug-mode diagnostic logging via logger.js.

nodes.label: devtools.html
nodes.rationale: HTML entry point for DevTools panel.

nodes.label: panel.html
nodes.rationale: HTML entry point for main extension panel.

nodes.label: Cohesion Over Line Count
nodes.rationale: Architectural invariant: a module holds one thing that changes for one reason. Length is a symptom, not the defect. Split when two parts change independently.
